reason: Plan Phase 5, the shadow inside its own scissor scope, with that scope's corner written on the mask that owns it. r56 ran 2026-10-31 and its photo is the malformation: the dark part of the gauge on the left, where the filled part is, colour on the right. The run refutes the corner premise. main+0xa4ba94 (the mask's enter) converts the authored pair at +0xa8/+0xac to floats and calls main+0xa4b390 with the node itself; the builder folds that node's transform at +0x10..+0x48 with the authored pair and the enter takes min/max of the four corners into +0xb0..+0xbc, so the box corner is the mask's own matrix translation at +0x40/+0x44 and the authored width spans forward from it. No parent field and no +0xe0 is read, and a mask object is 0xd0 bytes, so writing the anchor's rectangle at +0xe0 wrote past the end of the node. The class factory fills the translation with the gauge's corner (110,38), which is what the accepted mask's box 110 38 110+kept 166 shows, so every mask from that factory boxes from the bar's left corner and the accepted cut needs no corner write. r57 drops the anchor and writes the clip mask's own translation per frame to the cut's right edge and the bar's rect top, keeping the authored pair (width = the part of the blade past the cut, height = the bar's rect height): 128..200 px at 0%, 164..200 at 50%, and 238..239 - off the blade - at 100% on the measured bar. The copy keeps the bar's quad from the build (r53's read-back: rect 110 38 238 166, size 88.0 24.0) and its atlas window follows the bar's live tier band. Colour #202326 = 0xFF262320. r44's accepted cut and endpoints are untouched. 6 tree nodes, 7-word object array, (6 << 4) | 8 = 104 bytes = 13 records, and the walk emits exactly 13. 23 host fixtures pass; verify PASSED with 33 signature windows. Gameplay NOT RUN.
